feedback: Approved to race. The candidate is valid and changes only kp (3.0 to 2.6) and base_speed (1.3 to 1.2) from iteration 3, the best raced design (683.18). Geometry, ki 0.05, kd 0.8, sensor_weights and line_loss are unchanged, so the race isolates corner gain and speed. Evidence for the change: iteration 3 cut base_speed from 1.4 to 1.3 and raised kd to 0.8, and the slalom still went off track at max_error 0.0646 (0/20 finishes) with line_loss_events up from 1.0 to 1.45. Lowering speed alone did not bring slalom max_error under 0.06, so the untested lever is kp. Oval (20/20, mean 1.79 s) and s-bend (20/20, mean 2.21 s) both have time margin for 1.2 m/s, but the 3 s limit still has to be met on the s-bend. Read the result by track. If the oval or s-bend finish rate falls below 1.0, return base_speed to 1.3 and keep kp 2.6. If the slalom still goes off track with max_error above 0.06 while line_loss_events stay at or above about 1.4, the line-loss increase may come from kd 0.8 rather than speed, so test kd 0.7 with kp 2.6 at base_speed 1.2 to see whether the loss count falls. Do not change geometry until the controller question is settled.
requested_changes: If the oval or s-bend finish rate drops below 1.0, or the s-bend completion_time rises above about 2.7 s, set base_speed back to 1.3 and keep kp 2.6. Iteration 3 finished both tracks 20/20 at base_speed 1.3.

If the slalom still ends off track with max_error above 0.06 and line_loss_events stay near or above 1.4, set kd from 0.8 to 0.7 with kp 2.6 and base_speed 1.2. Iteration 2 (kd 0.7) had 1.0 slalom line losses against 1.45 at kd 0.8.
If the slalom max_error falls below 0.06 with some slalom finishes, keep kp 2.6 and base_speed 1.2 and hold geometry fixed, then test a small kd or ki change only if line losses remain high.
